tsa-a22-v01.quick_english: Now this entire worship is taught through the glorious Kaula method, for the fit ones mounted on firm resolve of exactly that awakened kind. On this point it is said in the Yogasaṃcāra and the rest: bliss is Brahman — in the body, established threefold at lips and lowest end.

tsa-a22-v02.quick_english: Those who abandon it, not abiding in Brahman, are cut off from bliss.

tsa-a22-v03.quick_english: Sacrificers of the wheel who feed on blissless artificial food —

tsa-a22-v04.quick_english: both fall into dreadful hell. Therefore one should keep to this stance.

tsa-a22-v05.quick_english: So through this stance there is Kula-sacrifice, and it is sixfold: in the outer, in the Śakti, in one's own body, in the couple, in breath, and in consciousness.

tsa-a22-v06.quick_english: Among these, each later one is higher; each earlier one serves to give a taste for it.

tsa-a22-v07.quick_english: For one desiring powers, the second, fourth, and fifth are to be performed in every way; for one desiring release the sixth is chief — though even for him the second and the rest are to be done on occasional rites as far as possible, and to complete the rite.

tsa-a22-v08.quick_english: Of these, the outer is the altar, full of bliss; the hero's cup, a red cloth, or else the liṅga and the rest mentioned before.

tsa-a22-v09.quick_english: There, with no need for bathing and the rest of the duties — purity gained by resting in full bliss alone — first, having contemplated the oneness of breath, consciousness, and body, one should utter the mantra twenty-seven times over crown, face, heart, secret place, and body, in forward and reverse order, since consciousness is Paramaśiva's own form: the fullness of the universe-course in the Supreme Lord — in the lower, in the middle, and in the highest alike.

tsa-a22-v10.quick_english: For thus: from Māyā, person, nature, intellect beginning down to earth, twenty-seven tattvas — kalā and the rest included therein — and likewise in the knowledge-power in the middle state, the qualities of the Brahman-pentad, beginning with instant-ness, born-ness, and become-arisen-ness, are just twenty-seven in form — so state the glorious Lakulīśa masters.

tsa-a22-v11.quick_english: In the highest too the Lord is five-powered: per power, five forms — so twenty-five powers. Mutually undivided, they are one power, still undivided — so, by a pervasion twenty-seven-formed, one should bind the buddhi-and-breath-formed flame of consciousness-fire with a single utterance alone, so that only Paramaśiva stays bound and it runs to nothing beyond the tantra. Penetrated thus, one should make the present offering-substance, house, directions, and supports made of that; then fill the offering vessel by the tuft-binding pervasion alone and worship it; with its drops worship the altars too; by joining left ring-finger with thumb, worship and satisfy the mantra-wheel on the body-wheels with its essence. Then up to breath; then fashion the trident-formed seat ending in the three powers on the altar — up to Māyā in the lettered auṃ-syllable fashion the seat ending in the three powers — up to Māyā in the lettered auṃ-syllable; thereupon the power to be worshipped, deliberation-formed. Thus, by a single utterance alone, having made the placing of support and supported, one should see the universe right there, even in the consciousness that has become the supported — and that too made of consciousness. Thus the universe by consciousness, and by that, her mutual enclosure comes about: arisen from consciousness, it comes to rest right there — since the universe arises from the knowable, and consciousness rests right there. Just this much is the consciousness-principle, attained through the twofold enclosure.

tsa-a22-v12.quick_english: So it is said: having enclosed emission —

tsa-a22-v13.quick_english: Then, having offered incense, smoke, wine, flowers and the rest down to self-surrender, having muttered in one's own rest, having gathered it in, one should cast it into water.

tsa-a22-v15.quick_english: Now for the Śakti. There, goddesses and heroes of the Śakti-circle being mutually of both natures — from the awakening of Śiva and Śakti spanning play's beginning to emission's end, through mutual activity, by the Supreme Lord's ordainment, in pure form — preeminence lies there. By this, even the distinguished wheel's Śakti-ness is explained. There, worship is by the tuft-binding pervasion alone, on the seat ending in the three powers; in the triangle, in the middle, the emission-power — but in the pervasion lies the distinction.

tsa-a22-v16.quick_english: So in one's own body: in that very wheel; then in the sub-wheels beginning with the crown-aperture.

tsa-a22-v17.quick_english: Now for the couple. This is the mark of the Śakti: like that, non-difference. Then, disregarding age, birth and the rest, from non-attachment — for identity is born of the transgressive pair.

tsa-a22-v18.quick_english: From being arisen together with cause and effect, threefold — directly, or else as arranged — the two, having worshipped each other, make bliss proximate by satisfying.

tsa-a22-v19.quick_english: One should worship the wheel according to its fitness, and likewise the following sub-wheel — outside with flowers and the rest, inward with perfumes, foods, wines and the rest.

tsa-a22-v20.quick_english: Thus the state surging with the play of that bliss-mass; the host of sub-wheels dissolves from identity with the wheel.

tsa-a22-v21.quick_english: In the relish of own-being at the time of unfolding of each enjoyment, gradually the sub-wheel goddesses enter the middle consciousness-wheel.

tsa-a22-v22.quick_english: Whose power is won by filling the host of rays embodied in sub-wheel goddesses — having the nature of that power, like that — becomes mutually facing.

tsa-a22-v23.quick_english: The agitation born of the throbbing entry into the upper abode of that pair agitates the sub-wheels too — then made of that, not separate.

tsa-a22-v24.quick_english: Thus this couple, whose talk of difference is dissolved — just when, then through gradation and excellence she indeed is the collision of consciousness and emission.

tsa-a22-v25.quick_english: The steady supreme abode of that — the both-natured vast world — bliss is neither calm nor arisen: the womb-cause of calm and arisen, the supreme Kaula.

tsa-a22-v26.quick_english: Desiring the undivided station, one should make her consciousness one's own; then the calm-and-arisen-natured pair arises at once for power and power-bearer.

tsa-a22-v27.quick_english: From self-and-other interpenetration, when calm and other — of the two, from two-naturedness — power, like that arisen one, nourishes emission; its bearer does not.

tsa-a22-v28.quick_english: In her is the excellent Kula; then by her, among men, the taught yoga-collisions — then, in the twofold emission, in this calm-arisen abode, those who contemplate —

tsa-a22-v29.quick_english: In the eastward one, mounted in the undivided station as emission-being — the arisen too is received mutually from mouths, from the chief mouth outward into the mouth.

tsa-a22-v30.quick_english: The goddess-wheel becomes satisfied, giving powers, knowledge, and release; in the practice of calm one attains the calm Śiva — which here is the deity-wheel.

tsa-a22-v31.quick_english: The void devoid of bliss — from bliss's own abode the offering — and the humming-thrilled with the taste of relishing outer states filled with own essence.

tsa-a22-v32.quick_english: The sub-wheel surging with inner fullness reaches the wheel; then that too surges as before. Thus this emission is threefold in implied sense.

tsa-a22-v33.quick_english: In the emission-abode, through relish, mantra-power bears each fruit in each consciousness-womb — three ways indeed.

tsa-a22-v34.quick_english: On the cover of eternal rising auspiciousness resting within the triangle, on the lotus — never parted the stalk, rooted in the true sixteen-petalled lotus.

tsa-a22-v35.quick_english: In the fire at the course of rubbing the pair of lotuses strung on the central stalk — from the collision of moon-beauty and sun-ray-floods in the middle.

tsa-a22-v36.quick_english: From union with the three-petalled ruddy power-ray, in the middle, sprout-emission — thus, by the seal of the wondrous gathering of moon and sun, in a flash.

tsa-a22-v37.quick_english: Performing within the order beginning with emission, one gains steadiness in the fourth — this in the entry of the sky-going seal, mutually, of one's own power and power-bearer.

tsa-a22-v38.quick_english: Who would be made of relish in drinking, enjoyment, play, laughter and the rest — with unmanifest sound, roar, burst, hearing, tone, and tone's end.

tsa-a22-v39.quick_english: That mantra-power, with unbroken unstruck ultimate realities — in rests of going and coming, in the ear, in the eye, in contact with the double mark.

tsa-a22-v40.quick_english: In the yoga of their closing, called body's end — and in the couple, in the wheel — which unmanifest, throat-reaching from the heart-place between the breasts to the lip's end.

tsa-a22-v41.quick_english: Having heard that lying between the two wheels, when agitation ends, they rest there — and thus this supreme eightfold Nāda-Bhairava.

tsa-a22-v42.quick_english: Since she is light and sound, that pervasion, mantra-bearing, is called highest — in every act the knower's would be release while living.

tsa-a22-v43.quick_english: Knowing that, liberated in scripture, a vessel of alien-Kula wisdom — the womb — one should make void-and-nonvoid abode, fire and wind in the single staff.

tsa-a22-v44.quick_english: Having made the trident of one taste — essence abiding in essence as it were — doubt abandoned, riteless: I am not, thus contemplating.

tsa-a22-v45.quick_english: Seeing the goddesses dwelling in the body — joy, agitation and the rest in consciousness-mass — the host of goddesses dwelling in the ear-eye-mouth-nose wheels.

tsa-a22-v47.quick_english: Always seeing the grasper, by Khecarī one succeeds certainly.

tsa-a22-v48.quick_english: In a far distant chasm, in a flash hurling one's own body — dwelling without violence, having drawn in both hands, gazing — one should practice this sky-going seal.

tsa-a22-v50.quick_english: In the stated-pervaded breath, made of the universe — by the taught consciousness-pervasion, strengthening through offering libation, food, perfume, incense and the rest — is breath-sacrifice.

tsa-a22-v51.quick_english: But rest's establishment is consciousness-sacrifice, already taught before.

tsa-a22-v52.quick_english: Thus, having performed any one of these sacrifices — if the disciple becomes one whose heart is painted with such doubtlessness — then for him, preceded by seeing that sacrifice, needing no prior sesame-ghee offering, one should perform initiation by a glance, in the order of contemplation by the aforesaid pervasion; but at the occasional rite's end for indirect initiation and the rest, the earlier alone is the rule.

tsa-a22-v54.quick_english: In the guru's body is the seventh Kula-sacrifice, most excellent of all — it too, performed once before together with the sacrifices, fulfills all. Śivam.

tsa-a22-v01.speaker: Teacher (kulayāga-prakāśana opening)
tsa-a22-v01.question: For whom is the Kaula teaching given, and on what authority?
premises: atha samastā iyam upāsā ... nirūpyate — the whole worship is set out now, not piecemeal.
śrīmatkaulikaprakriyayā ... prati — by the glorious Kaula method, for the fit ones mounted on firm resolve (samunmiṣat-tādṛśa-dṛḍha-vāsanārūḍhān).
yogasaṃcārādau uktam — the Yogasaṃcāra is cited as āgamic warrant.
ānandaṃ brahma taddehe tridhauṣṭyāntyavyavasthitam — bliss is Brahman, seated in the body at three places (lips and lowest end).
tsa-a22-v01.inference: Opening frame: audience (resolve-mounted fit ones), method (Kaula), warrant (Yogasaṃcāra), thesis (bliss-Brahman in the body) — the ahnika's charter.

tsa-a22-v02.speaker: Scripture (Yogasaṃcāra quote)
tsa-a22-v02.question: What happens to those who abandon bliss?
premises: abrahmacāriṇaḥ — non-abiders in Brahman (a + brahmacārin, ethical not celibate sense).
tasya tyāgād ānandavarjitāḥ — by abandoning it, cut off from bliss.

tsa-a22-v03.speaker: Scripture (quote continued)
tsa-a22-v03.question: Who else falls?
premises: ānandakṛtrimāhāravarjam — without bliss, with artificial food (kṛtrima = forced, unspontaneous).
cakrasya yājakāḥ — sacrificers who feed the wheel thus.
tsa-a22-v03.inference: Second hell-bound class: mechanical feeders of the wheel.

tsa-a22-v04.speaker: Teacher (seal of the quote)
tsa-a22-v04.question: What follows from the two cases?
premises: dvaye 'pi narake ghore — both fall into dreadful hell.
tasmād enāṃ sthitiṃ bhajet — therefore keep to this stance (enām sthitiṃ = the Kaula stance).
tsa-a22-v04.inference: Conclusion: the two failures jointly mandate the Kaula stance.

tsa-a22-v05.speaker: Teacher (kulayāga schema)
tsa-a22-v05.question: What is the Kula sacrifice and its divisions?
premises: tad anayā sthityā kulayāgaḥ — so, in this stance, Kula-sacrifice.
sa ca ṣoḍhā — sixfold: bāhye śaktau svadehe yāmale prāṇe saṃvidi ca — outer, Śakti, own body, couple, breath, consciousness.
tsa-a22-v05.inference: The sixfold map that organizes the whole ahnika (u8–u16 outer/Śakti/body; u17–49 yāmala; u50 prāṇa; u51 saṃvid).

tsa-a22-v06.speaker: Teacher (ordering rule)
tsa-a22-v06.question: How do the six rank?
premises: uttara uttara utkṛṣṭaḥ — each later one higher.
pūrvaḥ pūrvas tadrucyartham — each earlier gives taste (ruci) for the later.
tsa-a22-v06.inference: Ladder logic: ascent by stages, lower rites as appetite-makers.

tsa-a22-v07.speaker: Teacher (adhikāra rule)
tsa-a22-v07.question: Who must do which?
premises: siddhikāmasya dvitīyaturyapañcamāḥ sarvathā nirvartyāḥ — powers-seeker: 2nd, 4th, 5th in every way.
ṣaṣṭhas tu mumukṣoḥ mukhyaḥ — for the release-seeker the 6th (saṃvid) is chief.
tasyāpi ... yathāsambhavam anuṣṭheyā eva — even he does 2nd+ on occasionals as possible, to complete the rite.
tsa-a22-v07.inference: Adhikāra split: siddhi vs mukti tracks; occasional rites bind even the mumukṣu.

tsa-a22-v08.speaker: Teacher (outer rite apparatus)
tsa-a22-v08.question: What is the outer setup?
premises: tatra bāhyaṃ sthaṇḍilam ānandapūrṇaṃ — the outer: bliss-full altar.
vīrapātram aruṇaḥ paṭaḥ — hero's cup, red cloth.
pūrvoktam api vā liṅgādi — or the liṅga etc. mentioned before.

tsa-a22-v09.speaker: Teacher (outer rite course)
tsa-a22-v09.question: How is the outer rite performed?
premises: snānādikartavyānapekṣayaiva — no bathing-duties needed; purity is pūrṇānandaviśrāntyaiva labdhaśuddhiḥ — gained by resting in full bliss alone.
prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃviddehaikībhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā — first contemplate breath-consciousness-body oneness.
saṃvidaś ca paramaśivarūpatvāt — since consciousness is Paramaśiva's form.
mūrdhavaktrahṛdguhyamūrtiṣu ... saptaviṃśativāraṃ mantram uccārya — 27 utterances over crown, face, heart, secret, body, forward and reverse.
viśvādhvaparipūrṇatā parameśvare aparatve parāparatve paratve 'pi — the universe-course made full in the Lord at all three levels.
tsa-a22-v09.inference: The outer rite in full: purity-without-bathing, oneness-contemplation, 27-fold utterance, triple-level pervasion.

tsa-a22-v10.speaker: Teacher (27-count ground)
tsa-a22-v10.question: Why twenty-seven?
premises: māyāpuṃprakṛtiguṇadhīprabhṛti dharāntaṃ saptaviṃśatitattvāni — 27 tattvas from Māyā to earth (kalā included therein).
vidyāśaktau api parāparatve brahmapañcakasya ... dharmāṇāṃ saptaviṃśatirūpatvam — 27 Brahman-qualities in the middle state.
uktaṃ śrīmallakuleśādipādaiḥ — so state the Lakulīśa masters.

tsa-a22-v11.speaker: Teacher (highest 27 + single-utterance effect)
tsa-a22-v11.question: How does the highest level complete the rite?
premises: paratve 'pi pañcaśaktiḥ hi parameśvaraḥ — highest too: the Lord five-powered, five forms per power = 25 powers, mutually undivided = one power.
saptaviṃśatirūpayā vyāptyā ... śikhāṃ buddhiprāṇarūpāṃ ... baddhāṃ kuryāt — by 27-formed pervasion bind the buddhi-breath-formed flame.
yena paramaśiva eva pratibaddhā — so only Paramaśiva stays bound; nothing runs beyond the tantra.
tathāvidhabuddhyadhiṣṭhitakaraṇacakrānuvedhena ... tanmayībhūtān kuryāt — the penetrated rite-substances made of that.
tato 'rghapātram ... pūrayet pūjayec ca — fill and worship the vessel; drops worship the altars; thumb-ring joining worships the mantra-wheel on body-wheels.
tataḥ prāṇāntaḥ — then up to breath; triśūlātmakaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet ... sārṇe aukāre — trident-seat to Māyā in the lettered auṃ, thrice stated.
tadupari yājyā vimarśarūpā śaktiḥ — thereupon the deliberation-formed power to be worshipped.
sakṛd uccāreṇaiva ādhārādheyanyāsaṃ kṛtvā — by one utterance the support-supported placing done.
tatraiva ādheyabhūtāyām api saṃvidi viśvaṃ paśyet — see the universe right there, even in the become-supported consciousness.
viśvasya saṃvidā tena ca tasyāḥ saṃpuṭībhāvo bhavati — universe-by-consciousness, and her mutual enclosure.
saṃvida uditaṃ tatraiva paryavasitaṃ — arisen from consciousness, resting right there.
etāvattvaṃ saṃvittattvaṃ saṃpuṭībhāvadvayāt labhyate — just this much is the consciousness-principle, from the twofold enclosure.
tsa-a22-v11.inference: The ahnika's doctrinal peak: highest-27, single-utterance binding, vessel/altar/wheel/seat filling, support-supported placing, universe-seeing, the saṃpuṭībhāva identity — closed by the etāvattva seal.
uncertainties: śikhā fork adjudicated (flame chosen; tuft sense reserved for śikhābandha below).

option_choices.reason: saṃvid-agni context selects fire-sense; tuft sense lives in śikhābandha, recorded not litigated

tsa-a22-v12.speaker: Scripture (seal verse)
tsa-a22-v12.question: What condenses the enclosure?
premises: tad uktam sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya iti — having enclosed emission.

tsa-a22-v13.speaker: Teacher (dismissal)
tsa-a22-v13.question: How does the outer rite close?
premises: gandhadhūpāsavakusumādīn ātmaprahvībhāvāntān arpayitvā — offer incense through self-surrender.
svaviśrāntyā japtvā upasaṃhṛtya — mutter in one's rest, gather in.
jale nikṣipet — cast into water.

tsa-a22-v14.speaker: Teacher (section seal)
tsa-a22-v14.question: What was this?
premises: iti bāhyayāgaḥ — thus the outer sacrifice.

tsa-a22-v15.speaker: Teacher (śakti-yāga)
tsa-a22-v15.question: How is worship in the Śakti done, and what is distinctive?
premises: anyonyam ... ubhayātmakatvena — goddesses and heroes mutually both-natured.
prollāsaprārambhasṛṣṭyantaśivaśaktiprabodhe ... parameśaniyatyā ca śuddharūpatayā — awakening from play-beginning to emission-end, by the Lord's ordainment, in pure form.
tatra prādhānyam — preeminence lies there; etena ... viśiṣṭacakrasyāpi śaktitvaṃ vyākhyātam — even the distinguished wheel's Śakti-ness explained.
śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūjanaṃ — same tuft-binding pervasion; śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ — same three-power seat.
koṇatraye madhye visargaśaktiḥ — in the triangle's middle, the emission-power.
iti tu vyāptau viśeṣaḥ — but in the pervasion lies the distinction.
tsa-a22-v15.inference: Śakti-rite = same pervasion, new center (visargaśakti in the triangle); preeminence doctrine stated.

tsa-a22-v16.speaker: Teacher (svadeha-yāga)
tsa-a22-v16.question: How in one's own body?
premises: evaṃ svadehe — thus in one's own body.
tatraiva cakre — in that very wheel; tato brahmarandhrādyanucakreṣu — then the sub-wheels from the crown-aperture.
tsa-a22-v16.inference: Body-rite: same rite relocated — body-wheel then crown-downward sub-wheels. Two lines, whole doctrine by pointer.

tsa-a22-v17.speaker: Teacher (yāmala threshold)
tsa-a22-v17.question: What defines the couple's Śakti?
premises: atha yāmale śakter lakṣaṇam etat — now the mark of the Śakti in the couple.

tsa-a22-v11.plain_english: In the highest too the Lord is five-powered: to each power belong five forms, making twenty-five powers. Mutually undivided, they are a single power, still undivided — hence by a pervasion twenty-seven-formed one should bind the buddhi-and-breath-formed flame of consciousness-fire with a single utterance alone, so that Paramaśiva alone stands bound and it hastens toward nothing beyond the tantra. Thus penetrated, one should render the present offering-substance, dwelling, directions, and supports made of that very stuff; then one should fill the offering vessel by the tuft-binding pervasion alone and worship it, worship the altars with its drops, and — joining the left ring-finger with the thumb — worship and satisfy the mantra-wheel upon the body’s wheels with its essence. Then, up to breath; then fashion the trident-formed seat ending in the three powers upon the altar — up to Māyā, in the lettered auṃ-syllable fashion the seat ending in the three powers — up to Māyā in the lettered auṃ-syllable; and thereupon the power to be worshipped, deliberation-formed. Thus, by a single utterance alone, having effected the placing of support and supported, one should behold the universe right there — even in the consciousness that has become the supported — and that too as made of consciousness. So the universe through consciousness, and through that, her mutual enclosure comes about: arisen from consciousness, it comes to rest right there — for the universe rises from the knowable, and consciousness rests right there. Just this much is the consciousness-principle, attained through the twofold enclosure.
tsa-a22-v11.sanskrit_cite: paratve 'pi pañcaśaktiḥ hi parameśvaraḥ pratiśakti ca pañcarūpatā evaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ śaktayaḥ tāś ca anyonyam anudbhinnavibhāgā ity ekā śaktiḥ sā cānudbhinnavibhāgā ity evaṃ saptaviṃśatirūpayā vyāptyā saṃvidagneḥ śikhāṃ buddhiprāṇarūpāṃ sakṛduccāramātreṇaiva baddhāṃ kuryāt yena paramaśiva eva pratibaddhā tantrātiriktaṃ na kiṃcid abhidhāvati tathāvidhabuddhyadhiṣṭhitakaraṇacakrānuvedhena purovartino yāgadravyagṛhadigādhārādīn api tanmayībhūtān kuryāt tato 'rghapātram api śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūrayet pūjayec ca tadvipruḍbhiḥ sthaṇḍilāny api tadrasena vāmānāmāṅguṣṭhayogāt dehacakreṣu mantracakraṃ pūjayet tarpayet ca tataḥ prāṇāntaḥ tataḥ sthaṇḍile triśūlātmakaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntaṃ tadupari yājyā vimarśarūpā śaktiḥ ity evaṃ sakṛd uccāreṇaiva ādhārādheyanyāsaṃ kṛtvā tatraiva ādheyabhūtāyām api saṃvidi viśvaṃ paśyet tad api ca saṃvinmayam ity evaṃ viśvasya saṃvidā tena ca tasyāḥ saṃpuṭībhāvo bhavati saṃvida uditaṃ tatraiva paryavasitaṃ yato viśvaṃ vedyāc ca saṃvit udeti tatraiva ca viśrāmyati iti etāvattvaṃ saṃvittattvaṃ saṃpuṭībhāvadvayāt labhyate

tsa-a22-v12.plain_english: So it has been said: having fully enclosed emission.
tsa-a22-v12.sanskrit_cite: tad uktam sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya iti

tsa-a22-v13.plain_english: Then, having offered incense, smoke, wine, flowers, and the rest, down to self-surrender, having murmured in one’s own rest and gathered it all in, one should cast it into water.
tsa-a22-v13.sanskrit_cite: tato gandhadhūpāsavakusumādīn ātmaprahvībhāvāntān arpayitvā svaviśrāntyā japtvā upasaṃhṛtya jale nikṣipet

tsa-a22-v15.plain_english: Now, in the Śakti. There — the goddesses and heroes of the Śakti-circle being mutually of both natures, from the awakening of Śiva and Śakti that runs from play's beginning to emission's end, through mutual activity, by the Supreme Lord's ordainment, in pure form — preeminence lies there. By this, even the distinguished wheel's Śakti-ness stands explained. There, worship is by the tuft-binding pervasion alone, upon the seat ending in the three powers; in the triangle, in the middle, the emission-power — but in the pervasion lies the distinction.
tsa-a22-v15.sanskrit_cite: atha śaktau tatra anyonyaṃ śaktitālāsāvīrāṇām ubhayeṣām ubhayātmakatvena prollāsaprārambhasṛṣṭyantaśivaśaktiprabodhe parasparaṃ vyāpārāt parameśaniyatyā ca śuddharūpatayā tatra prādhānyam etena ca viśiṣṭacakrasyāpi śaktitvaṃ vyākhyātam tatra śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūjanaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ koṇatraye madhye visargaśaktiḥ iti tu vyāptau viśeṣaḥ

tsa-a22-v16.plain_english: So too in one's own body: in that very wheel there; then in the sub-wheels beginning with the crown-aperture.
tsa-a22-v16.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ svadehe tatraiva cakre tato brahmarandhrādyanucakreṣu

tsa-a22-v17.plain_english: Now, in the couple. This is the mark of the Śakti: like that — non-difference. Then, disregarding age, birth, and the rest, out of non-attachment; for identity is born of the transgressive pair.
tsa-a22-v17.sanskrit_cite: atha yāmale śakter lakṣaṇam etat tadvad abhedas tato 'napekṣya vayaḥ jātyādīṃś cāsaṅgāt loketarayugalajaṃ hi tādātmyam

tsa-a22-v18.plain_english: From being arisen together with cause and effect, threefold — directly, or else in arranged fashion — the two, having worshipped one another, draw bliss near by satisfying.
tsa-a22-v18.sanskrit_cite: kāryahetusahotthatvāt traidhaṃ sākṣād athānyathā kḷptāvato mitho 'bhyarcya tarpyānandāntikatvataḥ

tsa-a22-v19.plain_english: One should worship the wheel according to its fitness, and likewise the sub-wheel that follows — outwardly with flowers and the rest, ending inward, and with perfumes, foods, wines, and the rest.
tsa-a22-v19.sanskrit_cite: cakram arcet tadaucityād anucakraṃ tathānugam bahiḥ puṣpādināntaś ca gandhabhuktyāsavādibhiḥ

tsa-a22-v20.plain_english: Such is the state surging with the play of that bliss-mass. And the host of sub-wheels dissolves through identity with the wheel.

tsa-a22-v21.plain_english: In the relish of own-being at the time when each enjoyment unfolds, gradually the sub-wheel goddesses enter the middle consciousness-wheel.

tsa-a22-v22.plain_english: That whose power is won by filling the host of rays embodied in the sub-wheel goddesses — having the nature of that power, like that — becomes mutually facing.

tsa-a22-v23.plain_english: The agitation born of the throbbing entry into the upper abode of that pair agitates the sub-wheels as well — and then they are made of that, not separate.
tsa-a22-v23.sanskrit_cite: tadyugalamūrdhvadhāmapraveśasaspandajātasaṃkṣobham kṣubhnāty anucakrāṇy api tāni tadā tanmayāni na pṛthak tu

tsa-a22-v24.plain_english: Such is this couple, whose talk of difference has melted away: just when it is so, then, through gradation and excellence, she indeed is the collision of consciousness and emission.
tsa-a22-v24.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ yāmalam etad galitabhidāsaṃkathaṃ yadaiva tadā kramatāratamyayogāt saiva hi saṃvidvisargasaṃghaṭṭaḥ

tsa-a22-v25.plain_english: The steady supreme abode of that — the both-natured, vast world — bliss is neither the calm nor the arisen: the womb-cause of the calm and the arisen, the supreme Kaula.
tsa-a22-v25.sanskrit_cite: taddhruvadhāmānuttaram ubhayātmakajagad udāram ānandam no śāntaṃ nāpy uditaṃ śāntoditasūtikāraṇaṃ paraṃ kaulam

tsa-a22-v26.plain_english: Desiring the undivided station, one should make her — consciousness — one's own; then the pair, calm-natured and arisen-natured, rises at once for power and for power-bearer.
tsa-a22-v26.sanskrit_cite: anavacchinnapadepsus tāṃ saṃvidam ātmasātkuryāt śāntoditātmakadvayam atha yugapad udeti śaktiśaktimatoḥ

tsa-a22-v27.plain_english: From the interpenetration of self and other, when there is calm and other — of the two, through two-naturedness — power, though arisen like that, nourishes emission; its bearer does not.
tsa-a22-v27.sanskrit_cite: svātmānyonyāveśāt śāntānyatve dvayor dvayātmatvāt śaktis tu tadvad uditāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān

tsa-a22-v28.plain_english: In her lies the excellent Kula. Then, through her, among men, come the taught collisions of yoga. Then — in the twofold emission, in this calm-arisen abode — those who contemplate —
tsa-a22-v28.sanskrit_cite: tasyāṃ cāryaṃ kulam atha tayā nṛṣu proktayogasaṃghaṭṭān atha sṛṣṭe dvitaye 'smin śāntoditadhāmni ye 'nusaṃdadhate

tsa-a22-v29.plain_english: In the eastward one, mounted in the undivided station as emission-being — the arisen, too, is received mutually from mouth to mouth, from the chief mouth outward into the mouth.
tsa-a22-v29.sanskrit_cite: prācyāṃ visargasattām anavacchidite pade rūḍhāḥ uditaṃ ca mitho vaktrān mukhyād vaktre pragṛhyate ca bahiḥ

tsa-a22-v30.plain_english: The goddess-wheel becomes satisfied, bestowing powers, knowledge, and release. In the practice of calm, one attains the calm Śiva — which here is the wheel of deities.
tsa-a22-v30.sanskrit_cite: tṛptaṃ devīcakraṃ siddhijñānāpavargadaṃ bhavati śāntābhyāse śāntaṃ śivam eti yad atra devatācakram

tsa-a22-v31.plain_english: The void, devoid of bliss — from bliss's own abode the offering — and the humming-thrilled ones, through the taste of relishing outward states filled with one's own essence.
tsa-a22-v31.sanskrit_cite: śūnyaṃ nirānandamayaṃ nirvṛtinijadhāmato 'rghaṃ ca raṇaraṇakarasān nijarasabharitabahirbhāvacarvaṇarasena

tsa-a22-v32.plain_english: The sub-wheel surging with inner fullness reaches the wheel; then that too surges as before. Thus this emission is threefold in its implied sense.
tsa-a22-v32.sanskrit_cite: āntarapūrṇasamucchaladanucakraṃ yāti cakram atha tad api ucchalati prāgvad iti trividho 'nvartho visargo 'yam

tsa-a22-v33.plain_english: In this emission-abode, through relish, mantra-power — in just three ways — bears each fruit in each consciousness-womb.
tsa-a22-v33.sanskrit_cite: etad visargadhāmani parimarśanatas tridhaiva manuvīryam tattatsaṃvidgarbhe mantras tattatphalaṃ sūte

tsa-a22-v34.plain_english: Upon the lotus that covers eternal, rising auspiciousness, resting within the triangle — the stalk never parted, rooted in the true sixteen-petalled lotus.

tsa-a22-v35.plain_english: In the fire at the course of rubbing the pair of lotuses strung upon the central stalk — from the collision, in the middle, of moon-beauty and the flood of the sun's rays.

tsa-a22-v36.plain_english: From union with the three-petalled ruddy ray of power, in the middle — sprout-emission. Thus, by the seal of the wondrous gathering of moon and sun, in a flash.

tsa-a22-v37.plain_english: Carrying out within the order that begins with emission, one gains steadiness in the fourth — this in the entry of the sky-going seal, mutually, of one's own power and power-bearer.
tsa-a22-v37.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭyādikramam antaḥ kurvaṃs turye sthitiṃ labhate etat khecaramudrāveśe 'nyonyaṃ svaśaktiśaktimatoḥ

tsa-a22-v38.plain_english: Whoever would abide made of relish amid drinking, enjoyment, play, laughter, and the rest — with unmanifest sound, roar, outburst, hearing, tone, and tone's end.

tsa-a22-v39.plain_english: That mantra-power, with unbroken, unstruck ultimate realities — in the rests of going and coming, in the ear, in the eye, in contact with the double mark.
tsa-a22-v39.sanskrit_cite: avyucchinnānāhataparamārthair mantravīryaṃ tat gamanāgamaviśrāntiṣu karṇe nayane dvilakṣyasamparke

tsa-a22-v40.plain_english: In the yoga of their closing, called the body's end — and in the couple, in the wheel — that which, throat-reaching from the heart-place between the breasts to the lip's end, is unmanifest.
tsa-a22-v40.sanskrit_cite: tatsammīlanayoge dehāntākhye ca yāmale cakre kucamadhyahṛdayadeśād oṣṭhānte kaṇṭhagaṃ yad avyaktam

tsa-a22-v41.plain_english: Having heard that which lies between the two wheels, when agitation ends they come to rest there — and thus this is the supreme eightfold Nāda-Bhairava.
tsa-a22-v41.sanskrit_cite: tac cakradvayamadhyagam ākarṇya kṣobhavigamasamaye yat nirvānti tatra caivaṃ yo 'ṣṭavidho nādabhairavaḥ paramaḥ

tsa-a22-v42.plain_english: Since she is light and sound, that mantra-bearing pervasion is called the highest: in every act, for the knower, there would be release while living.
tsa-a22-v42.sanskrit_cite: jyotir dhvaniś ca yasmāt sā māntrī vyāptir ucyate paramā karmaṇi karmaṇi viduṣaḥ syāj jīvato muktiḥ

tsa-a22-v43.plain_english: Knowing that, liberated in scripture — a vessel of alien Kula wisdom is the womb — one should make the void-and-nonvoid abode, with fire and wind in the single staff.
tsa-a22-v43.sanskrit_cite: tajjñaḥ śāstre muktaḥ parakulavijñānabhājanaṃ garbhaḥ śūnyāśūnyālayaṃ kuryād ekadaṇḍe 'nalānilau

tsa-a22-v44.plain_english: Having made the trident of one taste — essence abiding in essence, as it were — with doubt abandoned, riteless: I am not — thus contemplating.
tsa-a22-v44.sanskrit_cite: śūlaṃ samarasīkṛtya rase rasam iva sthitam tyaktāśaṅko nirācāro nāham asmīti bhāvayan

tsa-a22-v45.plain_english: Beholding the goddesses dwelling in the body — joy, agitation, and the rest in the mass of consciousness — the host of goddesses stationed in the wheels of ear, eye, mouth, and nose.
tsa-a22-v45.sanskrit_cite: dehasthā devatāḥ paśyan hlādodvegādi ciddhane karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam

tsa-a22-v47.plain_english: Ever beholding the grasper — by Khecarī one succeeds, certainly.
tsa-a22-v47.sanskrit_cite: grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā sidhyati dhruvam

tsa-a22-v48.plain_english: In a far distant chasm, in a flash hurling one's own body — dwelling without violence, having drawn in both hands, gazing — one should practice this sky-going seal.
tsa-a22-v48.sanskrit_cite: śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svadehaṃ saṃpātayan vāsam asāhasena ākuñcya hastadvitayaṃ prapaśyan mudrām imāṃ vyomacarīṃ bhajeta

tsa-a22-v49.plain_english: Thus this is the sacrifice of the couple.

tsa-a22-v50.plain_english: In the stated-pervaded breath, made of the universe — strengthening, by the taught pervasion of consciousness, through the offering of libation, food, perfume, incense, and the rest — that is breath-sacrifice.
tsa-a22-v50.sanskrit_cite: uktavyāptike prāṇe viśvamaye proktasaṃvidvyāptyā tarpaṇānnagandhadhūpādisamarpaṇena upodbalanaṃ prāṇayāgaḥ

tsa-a22-v51.plain_english: But rest's establishment is consciousness-sacrifice — already taught before.
tsa-a22-v51.sanskrit_cite: viśrāntirūḍhis tu saṃvidyāgaḥ prāg eva nirūpitaḥ

tsa-a22-v52.plain_english: Thus, having performed any one of these sacrifices — should the disciple become one whose heart is painted with such doubtlessness — then for him, preceded by the beholding of that sacrifice and needing no prior offering of sesame and ghee, one should perform initiation by a glance, in the order of contemplation through the aforesaid pervasion. But at the close of the occasional rite, for indirect initiation and the rest, the earlier rule alone holds.
tsa-a22-v52.sanskrit_cite: evam etebhyo yāgebhyo 'nyatamaṃ kṛtvā yadi tathāvidhanirvicikitsatāpacitritahṛdayaḥ śiṣyo bhavati tadā tasmai tadyāgadarśanapūrvakaṃ tilājyāhutipūrvakanirapekṣam eva pūrvoktavyāptyā anusaṃdhānakrameṇa avalokanayā dīkṣāṃ kuryāt parokṣadīkṣādike naimittikānte tu pūrva eva vidhiḥ

tsa-a22-v53.plain_english: Merely by the primacy of sacrifice is this so.

tsa-a22-v54.plain_english: In the guru's body lies the seventh Kula sacrifice, most excellent of all — and it too, performed but once before in the company of the sacrifices, fulfills everything. Śivam.
tsa-a22-v54.sanskrit_cite: guruśarīre saptamaḥ kulayāgaḥ sarvottamaḥ so 'pi prāg yāgasāhityena sakṛd eva kṛtaḥ sarvaṃ pūrayati iti śivam

essence: Whole worship taught by glorious Kaula method for resolve-mounted fit ones; Yogasaṃcāra warrant; bliss-Brahman three-seated in the body.
Bliss-abandoners, not abiding in Brahman, fall from bliss.
Mechanical wheel-feeders on artificial fare fall too.
Both failures jointly mandate the Kaula stance.
Kula-sacrifice sixfold: outer, Śakti, own body, couple, breath, consciousness — the ahnika's map.
Later rites higher; earlier rites ripen taste for them.
Powers-seeker takes 2nd/4th/5th always; release-seeker chiefly 6th, yet keeps 2nd+ on occasionals.
Outer apparatus: bliss-full altar, hero's cup, red cloth, or liṅga as before.
Purity without bathing through full-bliss rest; oneness-contemplation; 27 utterances over five seats forward and reverse; triple-level fullness.
Lower 27 tattvas Māyā-to-earth; middle 27 Brahman-qualities; Lakulīśa masters attest.

Highest 27 as 25 undivided powers in one; single-utterance binding of the flame; substances made of-that; vessel, altars, wheels filled; trident-seat to Māyā in auṃ; worship of deliberation-power; support-supported placing; universe seen in become-supported consciousness; mutual enclosure; consciousness-principle as twofold-enclosure attainment.
Having enclosed emission — the citation-seal.
Offering through self-surrender; murmuring in own rest; gathering in; casting into water.
Outer sacrifice closed.
Śakti-rite: both-natured circle, mutual activity, Lord's ordainment, pure form; preeminence; distinguished wheel's Śakti-ness; same pervasion, triangle-middle emission-power as the distinction.
Body-rite: same wheel in own body, then crown-aperture-downward sub-wheels.
Couple's mark: non-difference; age and birth disregarded from non-attachment; identity born of the transgressive pair.
Co-arisen with cause and effect, threefold, direct or arranged: mutual worship makes bliss proximate by satisfying.
Wheel per fitness, sub-wheel likewise; outer flowers, inner perfumes-foods-wines.
Bliss-mass-play state; sub-wheel host dissolves into wheel-identity.
Each enjoyment's unfolding relished; sub-wheel goddesses gradually enter the middle consciousness-wheel.
Power won by ray-host filling; of that nature, like that; mutual facing.
Throbbing upper-abode entry agitates sub-wheels into that-made non-separateness.
Difference-talk dissolved: she is the consciousness-emission collision, through gradation and excellence.
Bliss neither calm nor arisen: womb-cause of both, supreme Kaula.
Undivided station desired; consciousness made own; calm-arisen pair arises at once for both partners.
Self-other interpenetration: power nourishes arisen emission; the bearer does not.
Kula-in-her; taught yoga-collisions among men through her; contemplators in the twofold calm-arisen abode.
Eastward station; emission-being; mutual mouth-to-mouth reception from the chief mouth outward.
Satisfied goddess-wheel gives powers, knowledge, release; calm-practice attains calm Śiva, the deity-wheel.
Void devoid of bliss; offering from bliss's abode; humming-thrilled tasting of essence-filled outer states.
Inner-full sub-wheel reaches the wheel; both surge as before; emission threefold in implied sense.
Emission-abode relish; three ways; mantra-power bears each fruit in each consciousness-womb.
Triangle-inner eternal-auspiciousness lotus-cover; unparted stalk; sixteen-petalled true root.
Central-stalk lotus-pair rubbing-fire; moon-beauty and sun-flood collision in the middle.
Ruddy three-petalled power-ray union; sprout-emission; moon-sun-gathering seal in a flash.
Emission-first order within; steadiness in the fourth; sky-going seal entry, mutual, of own power and bearer.
Relish-made amid drinking, play, laughter; six sonic grades from unmanifest to tone's end.
Unbroken unstruck realities; going-coming rests; ear, eye, double-mark contact.
Closing-yoga at body's end; couple-wheel; throat-reaching unmanifest from heart to lips.
Heard between the wheels; agitation ended, rest there: supreme eightfold Nāda-Bhairava.
Light-sound mantra-bearing highest pervasion; knower's living release in every act.
Alien-Kula wisdom gestated as womb; void-nonvoid abode; fire-wind in the single staff.
One-taste trident; essence-in-essence; doubt abandoned, riteless: I-am-not contemplation.
Body-dwelling goddesses seen; joy-agitation in consciousness-mass; ear-eye-mouth-nose goddess-host.
Grasper ever seen; by Khecarī, certain success — fork held open.
Far-chasm body-hurling in a flash; nonviolent dwelling; drawn hands, gazing: sky-going seal.
Couple-sacrifice sealed: 32-unit yāmala heart closed.
Breath-sacrifice: universe-made stated-pervaded breath strengthened by taught-pervasion offerings.
Consciousness-sacrifice: rest's establishment, taught before.
Doubtless heart after seeing the rite: glance-initiation without sesame-ghee; occasional/indirect cases keep the earlier rule.
Sacrifice-primacy alone grounds this.
Guru-body seventh Kula-sacrifice, most excellent; once with the rest, fulfills all; Śivam; GRETIL ends, colophon verses absent.

rasa.dominant: jñāna with adbhuta and śānta weight (knowledge as enumerated rite, wonder at collision)
rasa.sthayibhava: prasaṃkhyāna (contemplative counting) opening into camatkāra at the saṃghaṭṭa
rasa.justification: The ahnika counts — six rites, 27 × 3, countdowns — and each count lands as rest; wonder breaks through at the yāmala collision (u24), the neither-calm-nor-arisen (u25), and the eightfold Nāda-Bhairava (u41).

Bliss neither calm nor arisen: womb-cause of both, supreme Kaula. Consciousness made own; calm-arisen pair arises at once. Power nourishes emission; the bearer does not. Kula-in-her; yoga-collisions among men; contemplators in the calm-arisen abode. Eastward station; mouth-to-mouth reception outward. Satisfied goddess-wheel: powers, knowledge, release; calm Śiva attained. Offering from bliss's abode; humming-thrilled tasting. Surge-and-return; emission threefold in implied sense. Relish; three ways; mantra bears each fruit in each womb. Triangle-lotus, unparted stalk, sixteen-petalled root. Central fire; moon-sun collision. Ruddy-ray union; sprout-emission sealed in a flash. Emission-first order within; fourth-state steadiness; sky-going seal entry. Relish-made enjoyment; six sonic grades. Unstruck realities; ear, eye, double-mark rests. Heart-to-lips unmanifest track. Heard between wheels; agitation ended: eightfold Nāda-Bhairava. Light-sound highest pervasion; living release in every act. Alien wisdom gestated; void-nonvoid abode; one-staff fire-wind. One-taste trident; I-am-not contemplation, riteless. Body-goddesses in consciousness-mass; sense-wheel host seen. Grasper seen; Khecarī success certain. Chasm-hurling visualization; sky-going seal. Couple sealed. Breath-sacrifice: universe-made breath strengthened by offerings. Consciousness-sacrifice: rest's establishment. Doubtless heart: glance-initiation without sesame-ghee; old rule for indirect cases. Sacrifice-primacy. Guru-body seventh fulfills all. Śivam.
sections.FUNCTION: Establishes the sixfold kulayāga ladder with its adhikāra split (siddhi vs mukti tracks), the 27 × 3 pervasion arithmetic (tattvas/qualities/powers) grounding the single-utterance binding, the saṃpuṭībhāva identity of consciousness and universe as the rite's fruit, and the yāmala heart (u17–49) where non-difference, mutual worship, sub-wheel assimilation, the calm-arisen pair, and the Nāda-Bhairava doctrine carry the Kaula claim — closing with glance-initiation and the guru-body seventh.
sections.KEY TERMS: kulayāga (Kula-sacrifice, sixfold: bāhya/śakti/svadeha/yāmala/prāṇa/saṃvid); ṣoḍhā (six-ways); ruci (taste ripened by earlier rites); saptaviṃśati (twenty-seven: tattvas, Brahman-qualities, powers); śikhābandha (tuft-binding pervasion); saṃpuṭībhāva (mutual enclosure of consciousness and universe); etāvattva (just-this-much-ness of the principle); yāmala (couple, non-difference-born); saṃghaṭṭa (collision of consciousness and emission); śāntodita (calm-arisen pair); visarga (emission, threefold); khecarī-mudrā (sky-going seal); nādabhairava (eightfold); avalokanā-dīkṣā (glance-initiation); saptama (seventh in the guru's body).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 22 closes the Tantrasāra's ritual arc (a03–a05 upāyas, a08–a11 cosmology/śaktipāta/adhikāra, a14–a16 dīkṣā rites, a18–a19 consecration/śrāddha): the Kaula method for resolve-mounted fit ones. Cross-links: Yogasaṃcāra (bliss-Brahman quote), Lakulīśa masters (27-counts), Tantrāloka 29 (kula-yāga, yāmalabhāva — parallel, not sourced).
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) charter — audience, method, warrant, bliss-thesis, twin failures, sixfold map with ladder logic and adhikāra split; (2) outer rite — apparatus, bathing-free purity, 27-utterance triple pervasion grounded by Lakulīśa counts, highest-27 binding, substance/vessel/altar/wheel/seat filling, support-supported placing, universe-seeing, saṃpuṭībhāva sealed with etāvattva, dismissal into water; (3) Śakti and body rites — same pervasion relocated, triangle-middle emission-power as the distinction, crown-downward sub-wheels; (4) yāmala heart — non-difference mark, social disregards, mutual worship, fitness-graded offerings, dissolution into wheel-identity, goddess-entry, mutual facing, assimilating agitation, saṃghaṭṭa identity, neither-calm-nor-arisen Kaula, simultaneous pair-arising, power/bearer asymmetry, Kula among men, mouth-to-mouth reception, triple fruit, bliss-abode offering, threefold emission, mantra-fruit chain, triangle-lotus, moon-sun collision, sprout-seal, fourth-state steadiness, six sonic grades, sense-rests, heart-to-lips track, eightfold Nāda-Bhairava, light-sound pervasion with living release, alien-wisdom gestation, one-taste trident with I-am-not contemplation, body-goddess vision, Khecarī success, chasm seal; (5) breath and consciousness rites — strengthening by offerings, rest's establishment; (6) glance-initiation for the doubtless, old rule for indirect cases, sacrifice-primacy, guru-body seventh fulfilling all.

lines: Whoever lets it go, straying from Brahman-abiding,
is severed from bliss.
And those who feed the wheel on blissless, contrived fare —
both sink to dreadful hell. Hold, then, to this stance.

without, in Śakti, in one's own body, in the couple, in breath, in awareness.

each earlier ripens taste for it.

for whom release is chief, the sixth leads — yet on holy days he keeps the second and the rest as he is able, to make the rite complete.

a crimson cloth — or liṅga and the rest, as taught before.

lines: No bathing, no preliminaries — purity won by resting in full bliss alone.

First know breath, awareness, body as one; then sound the mantra twenty-seven times — crown, brow, heart, secret, frame, forth and back — since awareness wears Paramaśiva's own shape: the universe-course fulfilled in the Supreme — below, between, above.

lines: Thus: from Māyā, person, nature, mind down to earth — twenty-seven principles, kalā and the rest within —
and in the knowing power, midway, the fivefold Brahman's moods — instant, born, become — twenty-seven in form. So sing the glorious Lakulīśas.
tsa-a22-v10.sanskrit_cite: tathāhi māyāpuṃprakṛtiguṇadhīprabhṛti dharāntaṃ saptaviṃśatitattvāni kalādīnāṃ tatraiva antarbhāvāt vidyāśaktāv api parāparatve brahmapañcakasya sadyastvājātatvabhavodbhavatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ saptaviṃśatirūpatvam eva uktaṃ śrīmallakuleśādipādaiḥ

lines: In the highest too the Lord stands five-powered — five shapes to every power, twenty-five powers —
mutually undivided, a single power, undivided still. By a twenty-seven-formed pervasion
bind the flame of the fire of awareness — shaped of judgment and of breath — with one sounding alone,
so that Paramaśiva alone stays bound, hastening nowhere beyond the tantra.
Mind ruled thus, make present gifts, dwelling, quarters, and ground of that same make;
fill the cup of offering by the crest-binding pervasion alone, and worship —
with its droplets worship the altars; with left ring-finger joined to thumb
worship and sate the mantra-wheel upon the body's wheels with its sap.
Then to the breath's limit; then raise the trident-seat that ends in the triple powers —
to Māyā's edge, in the lettered auṃ, raise the seat that ends in the triple powers —
to Māyā's edge, in the lettered auṃ — and thereupon the power, deliberation-shaped, to be adored.
Thus, with a single sounding, the placing of ground and grounded made —
behold the world right there, even in the awareness turned grounded,
and that too awareness-made. So the world through awareness, and thereby her embrace:
arisen from awareness, it settles right there — the world rises from the knowable, awareness rests right there.
This much and no more: the principle that is awareness, won by the twofold embrace.

murmur in your own stillness, gather it home, and cast it on the waters.

lines: So ends the outer rite.
Now the Śakti. Gods and heroes of her circle, each of both kinds,
awake — from play's first stirring to emission's end — Śiva with Śakti,
by mutual doing, by the Supreme Lord's decree, in stainless form: here the pride of place.
By this the chosen wheel too is shown Śakti-natured.
Worship here by crest-binding pervasion alone, on the triple-power-ended seat;
in the triangle's midst, the power of emission — yet in the pervasion lies the difference.

then in the lesser wheels that crownward open.

lines: Now the couple. Hear the Śakti's mark: even so — non-difference.
Set aside age and birth and all the rest, cling to nothing:
identity is born of the world-defying pair.

lines: Co-arisen with effect and cause, three-formed — plainly seen, or set in order —
the two worship each other face to face,
and by their sating draw bliss near.

lines: Praise the wheel as it deserves, and the lesser wheel that follows —
without, with blossoms to the innermost; within, with scent and savor, wine and more.

lines: Such the station that surges with that bliss-heap's play.
And the lesser wheels melt into the wheel's own self.
Tasting own-being as each delight unfolds,
the goddesses of the lesser wheels enter, in due order,
the middle wheel — the wheel of awareness.
Power won by filling the ray-host robed as lesser-wheel goddesses —
of that power's nature, even so — turns face to facing face.
The tremor born of throbbing entry to that pair's high abode
shakes the lesser wheels as well — then made of That, no longer apart.

lines: Such this couple, its quarrel-talk of parts dissolved: whenever it is so,
through rank and excellence, she herself is awareness clashing into outflow.

lines: That steadfast, unsurpassed domain — the world both-natured and vast —
bliss, neither settled nor risen: the womb and womb-cause of settled and risen, the Kaula supreme.

then the two-natured pair, the settled and the risen, dawn together for bearer and borne.

lines: From self entering other, other entering self — where calm meets else,
of the two, by two-naturedness — she, power, though risen even so, feeds forth the outflow;
its bearer does not.
tsa-a22-v27.sanskrit_cite: svātmānyonyāveśāt śāntānyatve dvayor dvayātmatvāt śaktis tu tadvad uditāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān

lines: In her the noble clan; through her, among men, the taught yoga-clashes.
Then — in the twofold outflow, in this settled-and-risen domain — whoever contemplates —

the risen too is passed from mouth to mouth, from the chief mouth outward to the mouth.

lines: The goddess-wheel grows replete, granting powers, wisdom, release.
Practice stillness, and reach still Śiva — here the wheel of goddesses.

and the murmuring thrilled, tasting outward moods brimmed with own sap.

So this outflow's hidden sense is threefold.

lines: In this outflow's abode, by savoring — in these three ways alone —
mantra-might bears each fruit in every womb of knowing.

lines: On the lotus canopied with ever-dawning grace that lodges in the triangle's heart —
the stalk never sundered, rooted in the true sixteen-petalled lotus.
In the flame at the churning-course of the twin lotuses strung on the central stem —
from the central crash of moon-loveliness and the sun's gushing hosts.
Wed to the three-petalled ruddy shoot of power — in the midst, the sprouting forth.
Thus, by the seal of moon and sun wondrously met — in a flash.
Working the outflow-first order within, win firm ground in the fourth —
in the sky-farer's seal-entry, each facing each, of own power and its lord.

lines: Who would dwell savor-made amid drink and delight, play and laughter —
through unvoiced voice, roar, outburst, hearkening, humming, hum's end.
That mantra-might, in truths unbroken and unstruck —
in the pauses of outward and homeward going, in ear, in eye, where the twin marks meet.

lines: In the yoga of their sealing, called the body's far end —
in the couple too, in the wheel — what, throat-faring from the heart between the breasts to the lip's verge, stays unvoiced.

lines: Hearing what dwells between the twin wheels — when the tremor ends, they settle there.
So this, eightfold and uttermost: Nāda-Bhairava.

lines: Since she is radiance and resonance, that mantra-clad pervasion is named highest:
in every deed the knower's — living, freedom.

lines: Knowing That, freed amid scriptures — a stranger-clan wisdom's vessel is the womb.
Make the abode where void and non-void meet, fire and wind in the single staff.
tsa-a22-v43.sanskrit_cite: tajjñaḥ śāstre muktaḥ parakulavijñānabhājanaṃ garbhaḥ śūnyāśūnyālayaṃ kuryād ekadaṇḍe 'nalānilau

doubt cast off, rite renounced: I am not — thus brood.

the goddess-host throned in ear-wheel, eye, mouth, and nose.

gather both hands, gaze outward: serve this sky-faring seal.

In breath — stated, pervaded, world-made — strengthening by libation, food, scent, smoke, and all given up, through the taught awareness-pervasion: this is breath-rite.

lines: Having honored any one of these rites — should the learner's heart be dyed with such doubtlessness —
then, the rite first beheld, with no ghee-and-grain beforehand, give him the glance that kindles, in contemplation's order, by the pervasion declared of old.
Yet when the moon of occasion wanes, for the unseen kindling and the rest, the elder rule alone stands.
tsa-a22-v52.sanskrit_cite: evam etebhyo yāgebhyo 'nyatamaṃ kṛtvā yadi tathāvidhanirvicikitsatāpacitritahṛdayaḥ śiṣyo bhavati tadā tasmai tadyāgadarśanapūrvakaṃ tilājyāhutipūrvakanirapekṣam eva pūrvoktavyāptyā anusaṃdhānakrameṇa avalokanayā dīkṣāṃ kuryāt parokṣadīkṣādike naimittikānte tu pūrva eva vidhiḥ

lines: By the rite's first rank alone is all this so.
In the master's body burns the seventh clan-rite, crown of all —
done once of old beside the rites, it fills the whole. Śivam.
tsa-a22-v54.sanskrit_cite: guruśarīre saptamaḥ kulayāgaḥ sarvottamaḥ so 'pi prāg yāgasāhityena sakṛd eva kṛtaḥ sarvaṃ pūrayati iti śivam

lines: Now the whole worship is set forth, by the glorious Kaula way,
for the fit, firm-mounted on resolve awake as this. The Yogasaṃcāra declares: bliss is Brahman — throned in the body, lips and lowest end, three-established.
tsa-a22-v01.sanskrit_cite: atha samastā iyam upāsā samunmiṣattādṛśadṛḍhavāsanārūḍhān adhikāriṇaḥ prati śrīmatkaulikaprakriyayā nirūpyate tatra uktaṃ yogasaṃcārādau ānandaṃ brahma taddehe tridhauṣṭyāntyavyavasthitam

lines: Who lets it go, straying from Brahman-abiding,
is cut off from bliss.
And those who stall-feed the wheel on blissless, contrived fare —
both sink to dreadful hell. Hold, then, to this stance.
tsa-a22-v04.sanskrit_cite: dvaye 'pi narake ghore tasmād enāṃ sthitiṃ bhajet

lines: In this stance stands the Kula rite, sixfold:
without, in Śakti, in your own frame, in the pair, in breath, in knowing.
tsa-a22-v05.sanskrit_cite: tad anayā sthityā kulayāgaḥ sa ca ṣoḍhā bāhye śaktau svadehe yāmale prāṇe saṃvidi ca iti

lines: Each later rite outshines the one before;
each earlier ripens taste for what comes.
tsa-a22-v06.sanskrit_cite: tatra ca uttara uttara utkṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvas tadrucyartham

lines: Who seeks powers keeps second, fourth, and fifth entire;
for whom release is chief, the sixth leads — yet on feast-days he keeps the rest as he may, to crown the rite.
tsa-a22-v07.sanskrit_cite: siddhikāmasya dvitīyaturyapañcamāḥ sarvathā nirvartyāḥ ṣaṣṭhas tu mumukṣoḥ mukhyaḥ tasyāpi dvitīyādyā naimittike yathāsambhavam anuṣṭheyā eva vidhipūraṇārthaṃ ca

lines: The outer: a bliss-brimmed altar, the hero's bowl,
a crimson cloth — or liṅga and the rest, as taught before.
tsa-a22-v08.sanskrit_cite: tatra bāhyaṃ sthaṇḍilam ānandapūrṇaṃ vīrapātram aruṇaḥ paṭaḥ pūrvoktam api vā liṅgādi

lines: No bathing, no preliminaries — purity won by resting in full bliss alone.

Know breath, awareness, body first as one; then sound the mantra twenty-sevenfold — crown, brow, heart, secret, frame, forth and back — since awareness wears Paramaśiva's shape: the world-course fulfilled in the Supreme — below, between, above.
tsa-a22-v09.sanskrit_cite: tatra snānādikartavyānapekṣayaiva pūrṇānandaviśrāntyaiva labdhaśuddhiḥ prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃviddehaikībhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā saṃvidaś ca paramaśivarūpatvāt saptaviṃśativāraṃ mantram uccārya mūrdhavaktrahṛdguhyamūrtiṣu anulomavilomābhyāṃ viśvādhvaparipūrṇatā parameśvare aparatve parāparatve paratve 'pi ca

lines: Thus: from Māyā, person, nature, mind to earth — twenty-seven principles, kalā within —
and in the knowing power, midway, the fivefold Brahman's moods — instant, born, become — twenty-seven in form. So sing the glorious Lakulīśas.
tsa-a22-v10.sanskrit_cite: tathāhi māyāpuṃprakṛtiguṇadhīprabhṛti dharāntaṃ saptaviṃśatitattvāni kalādīnāṃ tatraiva antarbhāvāt vidyāśaktāv api parāparatve brahmapañcakasya sadyastvājātatvabhavodbhavatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ saptaviṃśatirūpatvam eva uktaṃ śrīmallakuleśādipādaiḥ

lines: In the highest too the Lord stands five-powered — five shapes to every power, twenty-five —
one power, undivided still. By a twenty-seven-formed pervasion
bind the flame of awareness-fire — judgment-shaped and breath-shaped — with one sounding alone,
so Paramaśiva alone stands bound, hastening nowhere past the tantra.
Mind thus ruled, make gifts, dwelling, quarters, ground of that same make;
fill the cup by crest-binding pervasion alone, and adore —
with its droplets adore the altars; thumb to ring-finger joined,
adore and sate the mantra-wheel on the body's wheels with its sap.
Then to the breath's far edge; then raise the trident-seat of triple powers ended —
to Māyā's edge, in lettered auṃ, raise the triple-powers-ended seat —
to Māyā's edge, in lettered auṃ — and there the deliberation-shaped to adore.
Thus, with one sounding, ground and grounded placed —
behold the world right there, in awareness turned grounded,
awareness-made as well. So the world through awareness, and her embrace:
from awareness arisen, settling there — world from the knowable risen, awareness resting there.
This much, no more: the awareness-principle, by the twofold embrace won.
tsa-a22-v11.sanskrit_cite: paratve 'pi pañcaśaktiḥ hi parameśvaraḥ pratiśakti ca pañcarūpatā evaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ śaktayaḥ tāś ca anyonyam anudbhinnavibhāgā ity ekā śaktiḥ sā cānudbhinnavibhāgā ity evaṃ saptaviṃśatirūpayā vyāptyā saṃvidagneḥ śikhāṃ buddhiprāṇarūpāṃ sakṛduccāramātreṇaiva baddhāṃ kuryāt yena paramaśiva eva pratibaddhā tantrātiriktaṃ na kiṃcid abhidhāvati tathāvidhabuddhyadhiṣṭhitakaraṇacakrānuvedhena purovartino yāgadravyagṛhadigādhārādīn api tanmayībhūtān kuryāt tato 'rghapātram api śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūrayet pūjayec ca tadvipruḍbhiḥ sthaṇḍilāny api tadrasena vāmānāmāṅguṣṭhayogāt dehacakreṣu mantracakraṃ pūjayet tarpayet ca tataḥ prāṇāntaḥ tataḥ sthaṇḍile triśūlātmakaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntaṃ tadupari yājyā vimarśarūpā śaktiḥ ity evaṃ sakṛd uccāreṇaiva ādhārādheyanyāsaṃ kṛtvā tatraiva ādheyabhūtāyām api saṃvidi viśvaṃ paśyet tad api ca saṃvinmayam ity evaṃ viśvasya saṃvidā tena ca tasyāḥ saṃpuṭībhāvo bhavati saṃvida uditaṃ tatraiva paryavasitaṃ yato viśvaṃ vedyāc ca saṃvit udeti tatraiva ca viśrāmyati iti etāvattvaṃ saṃvittattvaṃ saṃpuṭībhāvadvayāt labhyate

lines: So sung of old: the outflow gathered into the fold.
tsa-a22-v12.sanskrit_cite: tad uktam sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya iti

lines: Bring smoke and wine and blossoms to self-surrender's feet;
murmur in your own stillness, gather home, and give to the waters.
tsa-a22-v13.sanskrit_cite: tato gandhadhūpāsavakusumādīn ātmaprahvībhāvāntān arpayitvā svaviśrāntyā japtvā upasaṃhṛtya jale nikṣipet

lines: So ends the outer rite.
Now the Śakti. Gods and heroes of her ring, each two-kind,
awake — from play's first breath to outflow's end — Śiva with Śakti,
by mutual doing, by the high Lord's decree, in stainless shape: here pride of place.
By this the chosen wheel is Śakti-natured shown.
Serve here by crest-bound pervasion alone, on the triple-ended seat;
in the triangle's heart, outflow's power — yet the pervasion holds the difference.
tsa-a22-v15.sanskrit_cite: atha śaktau tatra anyonyaṃ śaktitālāsāvīrāṇām ubhayeṣām ubhayātmakatvena prollāsaprārambhasṛṣṭyantaśivaśaktiprabodhe parasparaṃ vyāpārāt parameśaniyatyā ca śuddharūpatayā tatra prādhānyam etena ca viśiṣṭacakrasyāpi śaktitvaṃ vyākhyātam tatra śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūjanaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ koṇatraye madhye visargaśaktiḥ iti tu vyāptau viśeṣaḥ

lines: So in your own frame: in that wheel itself;
then the lesser wheels the crown lets down.
tsa-a22-v16.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ svadehe tatraiva cakre tato brahmarandhrādyanucakreṣu

lines: Now the pair. Hear the Śakti's sign: even so — no-two.
Set age and birth and all aside, hold nothing dear:
they are one who are born of the world-defying wed.
tsa-a22-v17.sanskrit_cite: atha yāmale śakter lakṣaṇam etat tadvad abhedas tato 'napekṣya vayaḥ jātyādīṃś cāsaṅgāt loketarayugalajaṃ hi tādātmyam

lines: Co-risen with cause and fruit, three-shaped — plain, or set in form —
the two adore each other, face to face,
and by their sating draw bliss near.
tsa-a22-v18.sanskrit_cite: kāryahetusahotthatvāt traidhaṃ sākṣād athānyathā kḷptāvato mitho 'bhyarcya tarpyānandāntikatvataḥ

lines: Praise the wheel as befits, and the lesser wheel behind —
without with blossoms to the inmost; within with scent and savor, wine and more.
tsa-a22-v19.sanskrit_cite: cakram arcet tadaucityād anucakraṃ tathānugam bahiḥ puṣpādināntaś ca gandhabhuktyāsavādibhiḥ

lines: Such the station surging with that bliss-heap's play.
And the lesser wheels melt in the wheel's own self.
Tasting own-being as each delight unfolds,
the lesser-wheel goddesses in order enter
the middle wheel — awareness' wheel.
Power won by brimming the ray-host robed as lesser goddesses —
of that power's own kind, even so — turns face to face.
The tremor of throbbing entry to that pair's high home
shakes the lesser wheels as well — then That-made, no more apart.
tsa-a22-v23.sanskrit_cite: tadyugalamūrdhvadhāmapraveśasaspandajātasaṃkṣobham kṣubhnāty anucakrāṇy api tāni tadā tanmayāni na pṛthak tu

lines: Such this pair, its part-talk melted away: when so it is,
by rank and excellence, she herself is knowing clashing into outflow.
tsa-a22-v24.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ yāmalam etad galitabhidāsaṃkathaṃ yadaiva tadā kramatāratamyayogāt saiva hi saṃvidvisargasaṃghaṭṭaḥ

lines: That steadfast, unsurpassed realm — the world both-kind and vast —
bliss, neither settled nor uprisen: womb and womb-cause of settled and risen, Kaula supreme.
tsa-a22-v25.sanskrit_cite: taddhruvadhāmānuttaram ubhayātmakajagad udāram ānandam no śāntaṃ nāpy uditaṃ śāntoditasūtikāraṇaṃ paraṃ kaulam

lines: Longing for the unparted station, make her — knowing — your own;
then the two-kind pair, settled and risen, dawn as one for bearer and borne.
tsa-a22-v26.sanskrit_cite: anavacchinnapadepsus tāṃ saṃvidam ātmasātkuryāt śāntoditātmakadvayam atha yugapad udeti śaktiśaktimatoḥ

lines: From self in other, other in self — where calm meets else,
of the two, by two-naturedness — she, power, risen even so, feeds the outflow on;
its bearer does not.
tsa-a22-v27.sanskrit_cite: svātmānyonyāveśāt śāntānyatve dvayor dvayātmatvāt śaktis tu tadvad uditāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān

lines: In her the noble clan; through her, among men, the taught yoga-clashes.
Then — in the twofold outflow, in this settled-risen home — whoever ponders —
tsa-a22-v28.sanskrit_cite: tasyāṃ cāryaṃ kulam atha tayā nṛṣu proktayogasaṃghaṭṭān atha sṛṣṭe dvitaye 'smin śāntoditadhāmni ye 'nusaṃdadhate

lines: In the eastward seat, firm in the unparted station, outflow-robed —
the risen too is passed from mouth to mouth, from the chief mouth outward.
tsa-a22-v29.sanskrit_cite: prācyāṃ visargasattām anavacchidite pade rūḍhāḥ uditaṃ ca mitho vaktrān mukhyād vaktre pragṛhyate ca bahiḥ

lines: The goddess-wheel grows full, granting powers, wisdom, release.
Keep stillness, and reach still Śiva — here the goddess-wheel.
tsa-a22-v30.sanskrit_cite: tṛptaṃ devīcakraṃ siddhijñānāpavargadaṃ bhavati śāntābhyāse śāntaṃ śivam eti yad atra devatācakram

lines: The void, unblest — from bliss's own home the gift —
and the humming thrilled, tasting outward moods brimmed with own sap.
tsa-a22-v31.sanskrit_cite: śūnyaṃ nirānandamayaṃ nirvṛtinijadhāmato 'rghaṃ ca raṇaraṇakarasān nijarasabharitabahirbhāvacarvaṇarasena

lines: The inner-brimmed lesser wheel, surging, attains the wheel; it too surges as of old.
So this outflow's hidden sense is three.
tsa-a22-v32.sanskrit_cite: āntarapūrṇasamucchaladanucakraṃ yāti cakram atha tad api ucchalati prāgvad iti trividho 'nvartho visargo 'yam

lines: In this outflow's home, by savoring — in these three ways alone —
mantra-might bears each fruit in every knowing-womb.
tsa-a22-v33.sanskrit_cite: etad visargadhāmani parimarśanatas tridhaiva manuvīryam tattatsaṃvidgarbhe mantras tattatphalaṃ sūte

lines: On the lotus roofed with ever-dawning grace that nests in the triangle's heart —
the stalk unsundered, rooted in the true sixteen-petalled lotus.
In the flame at the churning of twin lotuses on the central stem —
from the central crash of moon-loveliness and the sun's gushing hosts.
Wed to the three-petalled ruddy shoot of might — within, the sprouting forth.
Thus, by moon-and-sun-wondrous-meeting's seal — in a flash.
Working the outflow-first order within, win firm ground in the fourth —
in the sky-farer's seal-entry, each to each, of own power and its lord.
tsa-a22-v37.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭyādikramam antaḥ kurvaṃs turye sthitiṃ labhate etat khecaramudrāveśe 'nyonyaṃ svaśaktiśaktimatoḥ

lines: Who would dwell savor-made midst drink and delight, play and laughter —
through unvoiced voice, roar, outburst, hearkening, humming, hum's end.
That mantra-might, in truths unbroken and unstruck —
in outward-homeward pauses, in ear, in eye, where twin marks meet.
tsa-a22-v39.sanskrit_cite: avyucchinnānāhataparamārthair mantravīryaṃ tat gamanāgamaviśrāntiṣu karṇe nayane dvilakṣyasamparke

lines: In the sealing-yoga called the body's far end —
in the pair too, in the wheel — what, throat-faring from the heart 'twixt the breasts to the lip's verge, stays unvoiced.
tsa-a22-v40.sanskrit_cite: tatsammīlanayoge dehāntākhye ca yāmale cakre kucamadhyahṛdayadeśād oṣṭhānte kaṇṭhagaṃ yad avyaktam

lines: Hearing what dwells between the twin wheels — when tremor ends, they settle there.
So this, eightfold and uttermost: Roar-Bhairava.
tsa-a22-v41.sanskrit_cite: tac cakradvayamadhyagam ākarṇya kṣobhavigamasamaye yat nirvānti tatra caivaṃ yo 'ṣṭavidho nādabhairavaḥ paramaḥ

lines: Since she is light and resonance, that mantra-clad pervasion stands highest:
in every deed the knower's — living, freedom.
tsa-a22-v42.sanskrit_cite: jyotir dhvaniś ca yasmāt sā māntrī vyāptir ucyate paramā karmaṇi karmaṇi viduṣaḥ syāj jīvato muktiḥ

lines: Knowing That, freed amid scriptures — a stranger-clan wisdom's vessel is the womb.
Make the home where void and non-void meet, fire and wind in the single staff.
tsa-a22-v43.sanskrit_cite: tajjñaḥ śāstre muktaḥ parakulavijñānabhājanaṃ garbhaḥ śūnyāśūnyālayaṃ kuryād ekadaṇḍe 'nalānilau

lines: The trident made one-savored — sap in sap abiding, as it were —
doubt cast off, rite renounced: I am not — thus brood.
tsa-a22-v44.sanskrit_cite: śūlaṃ samarasīkṛtya rase rasam iva sthitam tyaktāśaṅko nirācāro nāham asmīti bhāvayan

lines: See the body-housed goddesses — thrill and trembling in mind's wealth —
the goddess-host throned in ear, eye, mouth, and nose.
tsa-a22-v45.sanskrit_cite: dehasthā devatāḥ paśyan hlādodvegādi ciddhane karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam

lines: Ever beholding the grasper — by the Sky-Farer, sure success.
tsa-a22-v47.sanskrit_cite: grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā sidhyati dhruvam

lines: In a far-off chasm hurl your frame in a flash — dwell gently, no force —
gather both hands, gaze outward: serve this sky-faring seal.
tsa-a22-v48.sanskrit_cite: śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svadehaṃ saṃpātayan vāsam asāhasena ākuñcya hastadvitayaṃ prapaśyan mudrām imāṃ vyomacarīṃ bhajeta

lines: So this is the pairing rite.
In breath — stated, pervaded, world-made — strengthened by gifts of cup and food, scent and smoke, through the taught knowing-pervasion: this is breath-rite.
tsa-a22-v50.sanskrit_cite: uktavyāptike prāṇe viśvamaye proktasaṃvidvyāptyā tarpaṇānnagandhadhūpādisamarpaṇena upodbalanaṃ prāṇayāgaḥ

lines: But rest struck deep and rooted is knowing-rite — taught long before.
tsa-a22-v51.sanskrit_cite: viśrāntirūḍhis tu saṃvidyāgaḥ prāg eva nirūpitaḥ

lines: Having honored any one of these rites — should the learner's heart be dyed doubtless —
then, the rite first beheld, with no ghee-and-grain before, give the glance that kindles, in pondering's order, by the pervasion of old.
Yet when the moon of occasion wanes, for unseen kindling and the rest, the elder rule alone stands.
